extensionDescription.message: Sends a Pushover notification to your phone when new mail arrives, optionally only for mail that is still in the Inbox after your message filters ran.

testMessage.message: Test notification from Thunderbird. Your settings work!

privacyText.message: When new mail arrives, this add-on sends its sender and subject (and, if enabled, a preview of the body) to Pushover (pushover.net) over an encrypted connection, using your own Pushover keys. Pushover then delivers it to your devices. Nothing is sent to the add-on's author or anyone else. No notifications are sent until you agree below.

labelDataConsent.message: I agree that sender, subject and, if enabled, a body preview of new mail are sent to Pushover.

credentialsHelp.message: Your user key is shown on the Pushover dashboard after logging in. Create an application at pushover.net/apps/build to get an API token.

keysMalformed.message: Pushover keys are 30 letters and digits long. Please check the highlighted field.

keysMissing.message: Please enter a valid user key and API token first.

tokenMissing.message: Please enter a valid API token first.

permissionDenied.message: Access to api.pushover.net was not granted, so this check can't run.

testSent.message: Test notification sent. Check your device.

accountsNoneSelected.message: No account is selected, so no notifications will be sent.

accountsPop3Hint.message: POP3 accounts that deliver into the global Inbox receive their mail in "Local Folders". Select that account for them.

labelInboxOnly.message: Only notify for mail that stays in the Inbox after message filters ran

inboxOnlyHelp.message: Mail that your filters move to another folder, delete or mark as junk will not notify you. The add-on waits a few seconds after the mail arrives and then checks that it is still in the Inbox, so notifications arrive slightly later. A very slow move on the server (IMAP) can still slip through.

filterHelp.message: One term per line. A mail must contain at least one of the terms; case doesn't matter. The sender is matched against name and address. Leave empty to allow all mail.

labelIncludeBody.message: Include a preview of the mail body

labelBodyCharLimit.message: Maximum preview length in characters (0 = as much as fits; Pushover allows 1024 characters in total)

labelShowAccountName.message: Show the account name in the title

labelSummaryThreshold.message: Send one summary when at least this many mails arrive at once

summaryHelp.message: For example when Thunderbird starts or comes back online. 0 turns summaries off and sends one notification per mail.

soundDefault.message: Default (as set in the Pushover app)

soundsLoaded.message: $COUNT$ sounds loaded, including your custom sounds.

placeholderDevice.message: All devices (use "Check keys" to list them)

labelDebugLogging.message: Write debug messages to the error console

debugHelp.message: Open it via Tools → Developer Tools → Error Console. Keys and mail contents are never logged.

savedWithoutConsent.message: Settings saved, but no notifications will be sent until you agree to the privacy notice at the top.
